entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: How are the Phantom Thieves doing?

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: Sounds like they had another[n]success, huh? That's cool.

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: I'm still rooting for them. I hope[n]they don't get discouraged and quit.

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: The war's still going on...

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: It's probably because they think I'm weak.

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: If only I was as strong as the[n]Phantom Thieves...

entries.speaker: Familiar Young Man
entries.en: Hey, kid. You may be small,[n]but you played a great game.

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: What, so being big is better?

entries.speaker: Familiar Young Man
entries.en: Hah, my bad. I didn't mean it like that.

entries.speaker: Familiar Young Man
entries.en: I just thought we should be friends,[n]since we're both gamers.

entries.speaker: Familiar Young Man
entries.en: The name's Takekuma. I make a[n]living from gaming, more or less.[n]Ever heard of me?

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: Huh? Takekuma, the pro gamer!?

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: ...Yeah, you're the guy from all those[n]videos online!

entries.speaker: Takekuma
entries.en: And you're the one they call the King, right?[n]I've always wanted to play you...

entries.speaker: Takekuma
entries.en: But I don't know if it's a good idea...

entries.speaker: Takekuma
entries.en: I mean, if I beat you, your rank will[n]definitely drop.

entries.speaker: Takekuma
entries.en: And I don't need people bashing me for[n]bullying a kid.

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: You just called me weak!

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: That's it! We're playing! I won't lose!

entries.speaker: Takekuma
entries.en: As I expected of the King...

entries.speaker: Takekuma
entries.en: Okay, let's get this started.

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: ...I'm gonna win! I have to...!

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: How...?

entries.speaker: Arcade Spectator
entries.en: The King is getting destroyed...

entries.speaker: Loud Spectator
entries.en: That's Takekuma, isn't it? He's awesome!

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: ...I missed!?

entries.speaker: Arcade Spectator
entries.en: The King lost!

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: ...Th-That doesn't count! Let's play again!

entries.speaker: Takekuma
entries.en: You got it.

entries.speaker: Arcade Spectator
entries.en: Wow. That's ten losses in a row.

entries.speaker: Loud Spectator
entries.en: The King got slaughtered![n]Ha! That's hilarious!

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: One more... One more game!

entries.speaker: Takekuma
entries.en: No matter how many times we play,[n]the end result will be the same.

entries.speaker: Takekuma
entries.en: We should probably stop, for your sake.

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: Shut up!

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: You cheated, didn't you!?
Calm down.
You're being a sore loser.
Yeah, you tell him![clr 27]

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: I-I am calm!

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: I wasn't supposed to lose...!

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: Sh-Shut up!

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: I wasn't supposed to lose...!

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: Right!? There's no way I could've lost...!

entries.speaker: Takekuma
entries.en: Man... I guess the King is just a little kid[n]after all...

entries.speaker: Takekuma
entries.en: Looks like I overestimated your ability.[n]I'd feel bad beating you again, so I'm[n]going to go.

entries.speaker: Takekuma
entries.en: Make sure you practice for[n]the next time we play.

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: Dammit...!

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: You've gotta be kidding me...
Don't get so worked up.
Get your revenge.[clr 27]
Pros are amazing, huh?

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: I'm NOT!

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: I didn't lose! If I lose, it's all over for me!

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: I will!

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: I'm the one who's gonna win in the end![n]If I lose, it's all over for me!

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: I-I'm pretty much a pro too![n]There's no one better than me!

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: I didn't lose! If I lose, it's all over for me!

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: I'm gonna beat him next time for sure.[n]This isn't over.

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: The strongest always win in the end.[n]Just like the Phantom Thieves...

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: Watch, I'll win for sure next time!

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: I'm not a loser, you'll see!
Shinya is more motivated[n]than ever before...

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: ...Crap, it's late. I gotta go...

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: Man, that Takekuma though![n]Telling me to practice for next time...

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: A grown-up shouldn't spend so much[n]time playing video games!

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: ...Today tired me out. I'll see ya later...
